provenance.procedure: GET /tv/12345/season/2 with an Authorization: Bearer <v4 read access token>; synthesised from the published TMDB v3 /tv/{id}/season/{n} contract (ADR-0026). Regenerate against a real token with scripts/capture-fixtures.sh tmdb season-2.
provenance.note: Synthesised: a second season whose second entry deliberately omits episode_number — an episode that cannot be given a stable S..E.. key. It proves the client SKIPS such an entry rather than mis-keying it, so this season yields exactly S02E01. The kept episode also carries an empty air_date, proving PublishedAt is the zero time when the source does not say.
